jobs.description: Role: Senior QA Automation Engineer About You: Are you the kind of engineer who sees quality as a technical challenge rather than a manual process? Do you enjoy building automated test frameworks, creating release safeguards and preventing production issues before they happen? Are you as comfortable writing code as you are designing quality strategies and identifying risks across complex systems? If you enjoy improving how software is built, tested and released, DFYNE could be exactly where you belong. About DFYNE: A picture paints a thousand words… and we’re sure you don’t want to sit here reading a corporate essay about who we are. Honestly, how can you really get under the skin of DFYNE from a few lines on a screen? So instead, go have a look for yourself, see what we’re about, what we stand for, and why people love us: www.dfyne.com . About the role — DFYNE Your Career: Before I tell you more about the role, let me introduce myself. I’m Bruce, Head of Development at DFYNE, and I’m looking for our first dedicated Senior QA Automation Engineer. This is a hands-on engineering role that will help define quality engineering across DFYNE. Reporting directly to the Head of Development, you will work alongside our Staff Software Engineer to build the test infrastructure, automation coverage and quality gates that allow our teams to move quickly without compromising reliability. You will help protect systems that handle commission payouts, refunds, inventory synchronisation, shipping labels and other business-critical processes where quality has a direct commercial impact. Attitude: • Ownership mentality • Engineering-first approach • Attention to detail • Risk-based thinking • Continuous improvement Key Responsibilities: • Build and maintain integration test infrastructure that runs against real databases and realistic service environments. • Design and implement automated regression coverage across business-critical workflows. • Own CI quality gates and contribute to release readiness processes. • Develop end-to-end testing coverage for revenue-critical customer journeys. • Create and maintain realistic and secure test data strategies. • Work closely with engineers to identify and prevent quality risks early in the development lifecycle. • Improve test reliability, execution speed and developer adoption. • Support incident investigations by identifying testing gaps and opportunities for preventative coverage. • Contribute to engineering standards, software quality practices and continuous improvement initiatives. • Collaborate with Product, Engineering and Operations teams to ensure quality requirements are understood and delivered. Skills & Experience: • 5+ years of experience in QA Automation, SDET or software engineering with a quality focus. • Strong TypeScript or Python development experience. • Deep integration testing experience using real dependencies including databases, queues and simulated third-party services. • Strong Playwright, Cypress or equivalent end-to-end testing experience. • Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD quality gates, ideally using GitHub Actions. • Strong understanding of automated testing strategies and risk-based testing approaches. • Experience building scalable, maintainable test frameworks. • Ability to write production-quality code. • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. • Strong problem-solving and analytical capability. Nice to Have: • E-commerce or payments experience. • Contract testing experience. • Performance and load testing experience. • Google Cloud Platform familiarity. • Terraform and Infrastructure as Code experience. So, what’s in it for you?: If you’ve made it this far down without being put off, brilliant. I’d genuinely love to hear from you. Beyond joining a work family and a genuinely great place to build your career, you’ll become DFYNE’s first dedicated quality engineering hire and help define how quality is delivered across one of the UK’s fastest-growing companies. You’ll build systems and processes that have a visible impact on reliability, customer experience and business performance. You’ll be part of a high challenge; high reward culture. jobs.title: Flight Test Engineer & Onsite Test Coordinator (all genders)
jobs.description: About Us STARK is a new kind of defence technology company, revolutionizing the way autonomous systems are deployed across multiple domains. We design, develop and manufacture high-performance unmanned systems that are software-defined, mass-scalable, and cost-effective. This provides our operators with a decisive edge in highly contested environments. We’re focused on delivering deployable, high-performance systems. In a time of rising threats, STARK is bolstering the technological edge of NATO Allies and their Partners to deter aggression and defend Europe. About the team You will be working closely with the Flight Test Team and reporting to the Technical Director. Your mission As a Flight Test Engineer & Onsite Test Coordinator , you are the "Conductor of the Flight Line." Depending on your seniority, you will be responsible for the end-to-end lifecycle of our flight test campaigns, from initial planning and hazard assessment to execution and deep-dive data analysis. Beyond the technical data, you serve as the primary Onsite Leader . You are the person who ensures testing priorities are crystal clear to everyone on the range. You manage the daily tempo, coordinate the crew, and ensure that every person, from pilots to software engineers, knows exactly which tests are being conducted and when. Your mission is to transform raw flight data into actionable insights while maintaining a high-tempo, disciplined, and safe testing environment. Responsibilities Onsite Test Coordination & Leadership Act as the Onsite Test Coordinator: Lead daily operations on the range, ensuring the team stays focused on the primary test objectives. Clarify Priorities: Maintain and communicate the "Daily Flight Schedule," ensuring everyone knows the sequence of events and current testing priorities. Lead Briefings: Drive the morning "Pre-Flight Brief" and the evening "Debrief," capturing critical feedback and setting goals for the following day. Resource Management: Coordinate the availability of airframes, ground support equipment, and personnel to maximize range time efficiency. Flight Execution & Safety Coordinate and execute UAV flight tests in compliance with regulatory requirements and STARK safety standards. Ensure all flight activities and anomalies are documented with high fidelity. Develop specific Flight Test Techniques (FTTs) and instrumentation requirements to capture critical performance metrics. Lead Flight Readiness Reviews (FRR) and contribute to safety review boards. Test Design & Data Analysis Develop comprehensive flight test plans, test cards, and rigorous flight test hazard assessments (FTHA). Process and analyze flight data using MATLAB or Python to validate system performance against requirements. Work closely with Ardupilot and PX4-based flight control systems to iterate on flight behavior and performance. Manage the configuration of flight test articles, ensuring all hardware and software versions are meticulously tracked. Qualifications Educational & Legal Background Degree: Bachelor’s or higher in Aerospace, Electrical, Mechanical, or Systems Engineering. NATO Citizenship: Must be a citizen of a NATO member state (due to export control and security regulations). Communication: Professional-level written and verbal English. Technical & Leadership Toolkit Coordination Skills: Proven ability to lead a technical team on-site (three pilots and one engineer), manage schedules, and communicate priorities clearly under pressure. Data Mastery: Practical experience in data reduction and analysis using MATLAB or Python . UAV Systems: Familiarity with Ground Control Stations (GCS), telemetry systems, and mission planning tools. Testing Rigor: Proven ability to plan and conduct system-level tests in an aerospace or defense environment. jobs.description: We are building the first AI-native platform for automated product compliance in MedTech . REMATIQ turn hundreds of page of complex regulations (like MDR and FDA guidance) into structured, actionable requirements that plug directly into our customers’ development and quality processes. Braun, and Novartis. We are backed by exceptional investors, having recently closed a Series A round. We believe in the value of in-person collaboration and work in a hybrid setup, with the team coming together in our office in the heart of Berlin-Mitte typically four days per week . What you’ll do As a Manual QA Engineer at REMATIQ, you will own product quality across the edge cases automated tests don’t catch and the bugs that need to be driven through to resolution. You’ll work closely with Engineering to explore unusual documents, broken inputs, interrupted workflows, non-deterministic AI outputs, permission edge cases, and other failure modes that are difficult to anticipate upfront. This is a hands-on quality ownership role. You’ll combine exploratory testing with disciplined bug triage, making sure issues are reproducible, prioritised appropriately, fixed, verified, and genuinely closed. You’ll own two things: Explore edge cases beyond automated testing. Automated tests check what someone thought to check. You’ll explore unusual documents, broken inputs, half-finished workflows, non-deterministic AI outputs, permission corner cases, and other scenarios that may otherwise be missed. Own the bug backlog from report to resolution. Reproduce and document incoming issues, assess severity, prioritise with the Engineering Lead, track fixes, verify them, and keep the backlog accurate and actionable. What you’ll bring Strong manual QA experience on web products, including exploratory testing, test design, and regression planning Experience owning bug triage and backlog quality, not just reporting issues and moving on Exceptionally clear bug reports with reproducible steps, environment details, and expected vs. actual behaviour Enough technical fluency to investigate before escalating: browser dev tools, logs, network requests, APIs, and basic system behaviour Good judgement about risk and the confidence to say “this isn’t ready” when it matters Fluent English, our working language Nice to have: experience in regulated domains such as medical devices, pharma, or finance; ISTQB certification; German. Why this role is interesting Quality is central to the product. Thoroughness is part of the work, not an afterthought. You’ll work with AI-enabled software. That includes testing non-deterministic AI outputs alongside more traditional product behaviour. You’ll work closely with an AI-first engineering team and MedTech domain experts.
